## PERTUSSIS
Pertussis also known as "whooping cough" is caused by Bordetella pertussis. CDC
recommends antibiotic therapy for those presenting within three weeks of
symptoms (cough). After three weeks, patients may not be infectious, and thus
antibiotic administration is not routinely recommended.
[Diagnosis of pertussis](orzc-gmenu-diagnosis-pertussis)
[Prevention of pertussis](orzc-gmenu-prev-of-pertussis)
## Treatment
[Azithromycin 500mg po day 1, then 250mg q24h for days 2-5 [O]](orz-set-abx-azithromycin-po-500-250-once-q24h-x4days)
## Alternative for macrolide intolerant or allergic patients
[Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h for 7 days [R,DI]](psjzid-trimeth-sulfa-1-ds-tab-bid)
